purpose: The fastest-and-safe claim: every arm executes with its shipped metering ON. Unmetered comparators are Ladder B and may never appear here.

claimContract.allowedSentence: Amu native with sealed fuel is fastest among the enumerated metered execution systems (zig->wasm32 and rustc->wasm32, each under wasmtime with fuel enabled) on all six required domains, on the recorded Darwin arm64 hosts, under the named perfgate policy.
claimContract.aggregationPolicy: the candidate must independently beat every enumerated system in every required domain via perfgate.core/qualify; no aggregate may hide a loss or an unqualified arm

safetyPreconditions.policy: a Ladder-A claim seals only when every one of these held during the measured run; a missing check is refusal, not a footnote
safetyPreconditions.candidateMeteringOn: amu artifact sealed with an explicit fuel budget; the runner records contextFuelConsumed matching the fixture's fuel rule
safetyPreconditions.comparatorMeteringOn: wasmtime invoked with -W fuel; fuel exhaustion demonstrated to trap on the comparator arm during the session
safetyPreconditions.candidateProvenance: amu compile emits and verifies provenance at the measured pin
safetyPreconditions.conformance: the amu suite is green at the measured pin on the measuring host class
safetyPreconditions.knownAnswers: every timed sample's result equals the manifest's known answer for its input

measurementConventions.candidate: in-process steady state via the raw W^X runner (100k calls after 10k warmup)
measurementConventions.comparators: per-call by slope between two in-module call counts, cancelling process, compile and instantiation costs
measurementConventions.barrierDisclosure: wasm twins that need a call-preserving barrier use a volatile round trip inside the callee, which the native asm barrier does not pay; any domain whose margin depends on that asymmetry is footnoted and excluded from the sealed sentence until a costless wasm barrier exists

requiredDomains.note: margin footnoted per measurementConventions.barrierDisclosure; excluded from the sealed sentence

standing.measured: 2026-08-29 on levi (Mac16,10 Apple M4), amu pin e2e7f32
standing.result: 12 of 12 system/domain pairs perfgate-qualified, +17.7% to +73.2%; loop-call margins footnoted as barrier-asymmetric
standing.sealedSentenceCoverage: five of six domains claim-grade; loop-call held back by the barrier asymmetry alone
